extraction.Name: William Grant
extraction.Occupation/Income: I do night police work at the St. Francis mission
extraction.NOTES: Has wife and five children dependent on him; states 'I sure would like to have the money they owe me; I have wished many times that I had never received my patent, I think I could have gotten along better without it'; not in good health — 'I've been doing night work at St. Francis for so long I'm run down, in health'; document notarized May 21, 1929; notary commission expires some date in 1932; County of Colo, State of South Dakota
